name_reason: Already fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global data) + chapter domain + descriptor 'ch21_end_scene_char_facing_table'. 'ch21' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30), not a Ghidra address residue. Name reflects the data type (table/array) and semantics (per-char-slot facing direction). No address residue present.
purpose: Chapter 21 end-scene per-character-slot facing-direction table; the prologue of fd2_chapter_21_end copies it onto stack scratch and passes it as arg3 (facing) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro.
logic_summary: Read-only const table. fd2_chapter_21_end (the sole reader @ 0x240FA) copies all 25 bytes into a stack array (six dwords + a trailing byte via the Watcom MOVSD prologue), then hands the pointer as the facing argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes it by character slot when placing the end-scene cast. No code writes to it.
datatype: const byte[25] (Ghidra: byte[25]; src: const uint8[25])
element_semantics: One facing-direction code per character slot (index 0..24). Values observed are 0x00..0x03, the game's 4-way facing codes. Contents: {0x02,0x02,0x01,0x01,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x03,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x03,0x02,0x02,0x02,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x03,0x03,0x03,0x01,0x01}.
notes: is_const = true confirmed by zero write-xrefs (only xrefs are READ@0x24138 and DATA@0x24133, both in fd2_chapter_21_end). src comment block @ chend2.c lines 147-156 already documents all three ch21 tables (pos_x@0x52228/pos_y@0x52241/facing@0x5225A) accurately and concisely; kept unchanged. Ghidra data plate was blank (null) so a concise data plate was created via PLATE_COMMENT (src remains source of truth).
